Welcome to my personal webpage! Here, I'll be sharing updates on my latest projects my interests, and all sorts of exciting content.

I'm also a data visualization nerd and I can't wait to share with you my insights on how to make stunning and informative plots. So, whether you're a fellow coding enthusiast or a data visualization aficionado, you'll find plenty of exciting content here.

I want to hear from you! So don't be shy, send me an email: Whether you have a question, a suggestion, or just want to say hello, I'm all ears.

Stay tuned for updates and feel free to leave a comment or send me a message. I'd love to hear from you!

<strong>SARS-CoV-2 (April, 2020)</strong>

<!-- <img src="images/new.gif" width="20px"/> -->
Due to the ongoing Coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) crisis, I've developed a Shiny library to track the progression of the data. The app is available in Spanish and is designed to be as user-friendly as possible, allowing anyone to easily interpret the data without needing any prior knowledge.

If you're interested, you can check out the application at the following link [(Click here!)](https://baguadoramirez.shinyapps.io/covid/). It's a simple but effective tool that has proven to be incredibly helpful during these challenging times to friends and relatives. I hope it provides you with valuable insights into the evolution of the data, and feel free to share it with anyone who might find it useful. 

Please, stay safe!\
